sections.text: PDGFRA encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha, a receptor tyrosine kinase.

sections.text: FIP1L1::PDGFRA was documented in 78 patients in a registry study of myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with tyrosine-kinase fusions, providing direct clinical evidence for this disease association.

audit_evidence.scope: All PDGFRA cases in this cohort had exact FIP1L1 partner; no independent kinase-domain functional proof asserted.

sections.text: Imatinib can induce durable hematologic, cytogenetic and molecular remissions in FIP1L1::PDGFRA-associated myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms.
